Icons.Title: Apply icons
Icons.Hint: Point imported items at the module's icons again, e.g. after a module update adds art.
Icons.Explain: Sets the module's icons on imported items in the world, on runners and NPCs, and in the Chummer SR6 compendiums. An image you chose yourself is never replaced: only empty images, Foundry's and shadowrun6-eden's stock images, and the module's own icons are. Portraits and tokens are not touched.
Icons.Done: Updated {updated} · kept {kept} you chose · {unchanged} already right.
Icons.NoIndex: The module's icon list couldn't be loaded (see the console), so no icons can be applied.
